description.value:
You touch one willing creature. At any point before the power ends, that creature may roll a d4 and add the result to one ability check of its choice, after which the power ends.

The bonus die improves to a d6 at 5th level, a d8 at 11th level, and a d10 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, At-Will
